name: Path of the Lost
descriptionTemplate: Agrippa gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: {Poison} applied by Agrippa increases by 50%. At the end of the turn, gain [Block:Arg2] Shield.
lore:
The mountain wind rustles through the bones of the maze, sighing.
She hears the cries of lost travelers and lets out her 8,001st yawn.
She sips on pain, categorizing and displaying it.
Only one issue—no one knows about her masterpiece; she is the sole audience.
Sigh—!
Seated in the deepest part of the maze, she yawns once more.

patch.descriptionTemplate: Agrippa gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: {Poison} applied by Agrippa +100%. At turn end, gain [Block:Arg2] Shield. Each time Agrippa inflicts or triggers {Poison} in the turn, this Shield +50%, up to 5 stacks.
